authorship: Author-held-out set written after all P3 rule and engine changes and before any evaluation run on it. Same author as the rules: not an independent or third-party blinded holdout. Labels state what is correct, not what the rules can detect.

ftp.provenance: Retained lab observation shape: 192.168.77.20 tcp/21 open (vsftpd banner, synthetic text)

ssh.provenance: Retained lab observation shape: tcp/22 open (OpenSSH banner, synthetic text)

output.summary: tcp/22 open ssh banner OpenSSH 4.7p1 Debian

smb.provenance: Retained lab observation: tcp/139 and tcp/445 open

bounded_http_paths.validation_criterion: Compare HTTP statuses for bounded paths without redirects; a non-404 response is a path candidate, not a vulnerability.

http_observation_template.validation_criterion: Capture the pinned informational single-response observation; it does not establish a vulnerability.
